title: US-Iranian Kamran Hekmati Released From Tehran Prison But Can't Leave Country
content: An Iranian-American citizen, Kamran Hekmati, has been released from Tehran's notorious Evin Prison, sources have told RFE/RL's Radio Farda, but he is unable to leave the country due to a travel ban.

title: 'They Save Us': Ukrainian Volunteers Rescue Pets Under Fire
content: Volunteers from Ukraine's UAnimals charity dodge Russian drones to rescue people's pets in cities under fire in the Donetsk region. They've saved hundreds of animals, from beloved dogs and cats to jittery goats and raccoons, delivering them to new homes in safer areas far from the front lines.

title: From Al-Qaeda To Lone Wolves And AI: How Terrorism Has Changed Since 9/11
